nexscope/inputExamples.prompt: Keep the product consistent and generate a clean white-background ecommerce hero image.

description: Generate ecommerce images with the Nano Banana base image model. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

imageUrls.description: Optional public reference image URLs. Omit this field for text-to-image generation, or provide references for image-to-image generation. When supplied, provide 1 to 10 JPG, PNG, or WEBP images; each image must not exceed 20 MB.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate. Valid range: 1 to 10; defaults to 1.

prompt.description: Generation prompt describing the target image, scene, composition, style, and constraints. Maximum 5000 characters.
prompt.example: Keep the product consistent and generate a clean white-background ecommerce hero image.

name: nexscope_banana_image_generation
title: Nano Banana Image Generation
